# material-shapes-ts

Vendored ESM build of `material-shapes-ts` 0.3.0 (Apache-2.0), a web port of
AndroidX Graphics Shapes.

Only the files needed to build the Material 3 Expressive loading indicator are
kept here: `MaterialShapes` provides the seven shapes and `Morph` interpolates
between them. The UI imports nothing else from this directory.

Source: https://www.npmjs.com/package/material-shapes-ts

See `LICENSE` for the license text.
